panels.title: Live Aerial Track Map  |  Aircraft · Connected UE · gNB · HO flash
panels.description: Layers: Prometheus aircraft plane SVG (lat/lon/heading) + GeoJSON sectors/GS/tracks/serving_links(lab UEs)/ho_live flash from browser-reachable http://localhost:9105/geojson/* (RFC7946, CORS). No persistent HO history on the map — white flash only while HO is live. A2G aerial — not satellite. Aircraft: Prometheus markers (ADS-B tails only; cyan plane SVG). Connected UE: orange GeoJSON ue1..ue3 with ue_id + cell_id badge (OAI lab). Towers: serving gNB bright #39FF88 size=44px; neighbor towers dim #8C9AAF. Serving beams restricted to lab UEs only (lab_ues_only) — no ADS-B green starburst. Track/serving/sector/HO-flash layers are line-only. Map tooltips: aircraft / ground gNB / Connected UE only (single mode). HO live flash = white LineString for lab/OAI UEs only (≤5s, ≤150 km, #FFFFFF) — no modeled A3 ADS-B flashes, no persistent HO history markers on the map. Overlays: browser GeoJSON from http://localhost:9105/geojson/* (CORS-enabled). Not exporter:9105. HO OAI success/fail only when CU log tokens parse (lab `ci trigger_f1_ho` = signaling demo, not measurement-driven A3). Sionna twin RF when atg_pipeline_up{{component="sionna"}}=1; else need Sionna. Diona tiles = baseline example (diona_*), not live Diona RF.

panels.title: Map data path
panels.description: Why Prometheus markers + localhost GeoJSON (not exporter:9105 / Infinity-only).

options.content:
**Aircraft** plot via Prometheus `atg_position_lat`/`lon` joined by `tail_id` (server-side plane SVG — works even if browser GeoJSON fails). `cell_id` text badge from `atg_serving_cell_info==1`.

**Tracks / serving links / GS / sectors / horizon** use core Geomap GeoJSON URLs at `http://localhost:9105/geojson/*`. The browser fetches these; `http://exporter:9105` only resolves inside Docker and produced the empty basemap. Exporter CORS allows `localhost:3000` → `localhost:9105`.

**Serving gNB** towers are bright green; **neighbor** towers are dim gray. **Serving link** beam is bright green LineString for **lab UEs only** (ue1..ue3 → active GS) — ADS-B aircraft do not draw serving beams.

**Cell geometry** shows four color-matched sector wedges. These are geometric overlays, not coverage claims. Horizon/sector/track/serving/HO-flash layers are non-interactive (no hover tooltip); tooltips appear only on aircraft, Connected UE, and ground gNB.

**HO live flash** is a short white LineString for **lab/OAI UEs only** (`ho_live?lab_ues_only=true`, ≤150 km) — modeled A3 on ADS-B tails is excluded (no metro diagonals). Modeled/OAI HO still appear in the HO table.

HO event table embeds exporter `/ho_events.html` (browser iframe — no Infinity datasource required).
